title: Western Strand
wikitext:
[[File:Western Strand.jpg|thumb|300px|Western Strand.]]

The '''Western Strand''' is a stretch of coastline in the southwest of [[Hillsbrad Foothills]], complementary to the [[Eastern Strand]] further east. The Western Strand is home to the many [[Torn Fin]] [[murloc]]s who have built small camps along the shore.
